summary: Full backend + frontend coverage of the 4 new features (logo upload/fetch, weekly debt digest cron, Pro gating on reports, live sync badge) against Convex deployment fearless-ostrich-878. Backend: 16/16 new tests pass (test_iteration13_new_features.py) + 71/71 regression (test_iteration11_convex_rest.py + test_iteration12_security.py) = 87 pass / 3 skipped. Weekly cron confirmed by running `npx convex run extra:weeklyDebtDigestAll` with the dev deploy key — returned {orgs:2, notified:1} and the function is NOT publicly callable via Convex /api/mutation (returns status:'error' / 'Could not find public function'). POST /org/logo (owner, base64 PNG) persists and GET /org/logo returns a `data:image/png;base64,...` data_uri; non-owner upload is rejected (401/403) and >1.5MB payload is rejected. /stats/reports: period=day works for everyone; period=week|month returns full data (not locked) for the LICENSE org_test_1 owner; invalid period rejected. GET /plans contains a 'Pro' plan (visible on /upgrade: 'Pro — 25 USD/شهري, حتى 15 موظفاً وموزعاً, تقارير أسبوعية وشهرية متقدمة, تحليل الأرباح'). The invite-limit error string in convex/employees.ts mentions Pro ('تم الوصول للحد الأقصى من الموظفين — قم بالترقية إلى Pro'). Frontend web preview tested at 390x844: owner, acct, dev, and dist (field-agent) home screens all render with `sync-status-badge` + inner `sync-status-synced` in the header. Owner → الإدارة → ملف المؤسسة segment correctly renders `org-logo-image` and `upload-logo-button`. `reports-pro-upsell` is NOT shown on LICENSE owner's /reports (correct — unlocked state with weekly/monthly data visible). `team-pro-upsell` is NOT shown on LICENSE owner's team segment (correct). /dist route group is now present (iteration 12 regression fixed). No red screens, no 'Unmatched Route' on any role. Only non-blocking caveat: a TRIAL org/token is not seeded, so the TRIAL-locked path for /stats/reports and the ProUpsell visibility branch were verified via code review (extra.ts:451 returns {locked:true,rows:[]} when plan === 'TRIAL'; ProUpsell.tsx:15 renders only when org.plan === 'TRIAL') rather than live token.

Good contract preservation for existing InvoiceActions / StatementActions / VoucherSheet.

Debt digest for STAFF via POST /debts/digest still works.

convex/employees.ts line 45 error string correctly mentions Pro.

AccountButton wraps <SyncBadge /> + notifications bell + profile — used by Overview/Dev/OwnerMore/NewSale/Customers/DistributorOps/Sales/dev-billing, so badge is visible on every role home as required.
